newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Japan's Hashimoto to meet April 25.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Japan's Hashimoto to meet April 25.

text.p: President Bill Clinton and Jpanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will meet in Washington on April 25, the White House announced on Wednesday.

Spokesman Mike McCurry said the two leaders would discuss "a full range of bilateral and international issues." He gave no other details on the agenda for Hashimoto's official working visit, but economic relations would figure to be a top priority.

Clinton paid a state visit to Tokyo in April 1996. He and Hashimoto have met on several other occasions, most recently at the November 1996 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders meeting in Manila.
